newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBf Capital won't appeal Negara decision.
newsitem.headline: MBf Capital won't appeal Negara decision.

text.p: Malaysian financial services firm MBf Capital Bhd said on Monday it would not appeal against a central bank disapproval of talks between it and financial company Suria Capital Holdings Bhd.
"Management has decided not to appeal the decision of BNM (Bank Negara Malaysia)," MBf Capital said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The company requested to the exchange to requote its stock from Tuesday as it had decided against an appeal.
Bank Negara did not say why it did not allow MBf Capital to talk to Suria.
The company was targeting the banking licence owned by Suria's Sabah Bank Bhd and had been hoping for some form of a merger between the two, dealers had said.
MBf Capital, which controls Malaysia's largest finance company, previously said it would consider an appeal against the Bank Negara decision.
